title: Gaza Clinic Par Israeli Strike Mein MSF Ke 2 Staff Members Ki Maut, IDF Ka Daawa
summary: Gaza ki ek clinic par Israeli airstrike mein MSF ke do security guards maare gaye. IDF ne unhe Hamas se juda bataya, jabki MSF ne is hamle ki ninda ki hai.
key_points: MSF ne bataya ki Gaza clinic par Israeli direct strike mein unke 2 staff members maare gaye.
IDF ne daawa kiya ki maare gaye dono shakhs Hamas ke operatives the.
MSF ke mutabiq unki building par clear logo the aur location IDF ko pehle se pata thi.
WHO chief ne healthcare workers aur humanitarian staff par hamle ki ninda ki.
body: Humanitarian medical organization Doctors Without Borders (MSF) ne kaha hai ki Gaza mein ek clinic par hue Israeli strike mein unke do staff members ki maut ho gayi. MSF ke anusaar yeh dono log clinic mein security guards ke roop mein kaam kar rahe the. Sanstha ne is ghatna par dukh jatate hue ise direct hit bataya hai.

Doosri taraf, Israel Defence Forces (IDF) ne hospital ya medical infrastructure ko target karne ke aarop se inkaar kiya hai. IDF ka daawa hai ki maare gaye log Hamas se jude the, jinme se ek artillery cell commander tha. IDF ne kaha ki Hamas aamtaur par international organizations ke beech chhipne ki koshish karta hai.

MSF ne social media par likha ki unki premises par MSF ke logos saaf dikh rahe the aur is jagah ki location Israeli military ko pehle se di gayi thi. Is hamle par World Health Organization (WHO) ke chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ne bhi aapti jatayi aur medical workers par hamlon ko unacceptable bataya.
why_it_matters: Conflict zones mein humanitarian aur medical aid workers ki suraksha ek bada mudda hai. Aise haadson se yuddh ke dauran zakhmi aur bimaar logon tak medical relief pahunchane mein aur rukawatein aa sakti hain.
